({{langx|he|הפועל ראשון לציון}}) is an Israeli [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Rishon LeZion]], which currently plays in [[Liga Leumit]], Israel's second football division. Home matches are hosted at the [[Haberfeld Stadium]]. In 1991, the club changed its name to Hapoel Ironi Rishon LeZion ({{langx|he|הפועל עירוני ראשון לציון}}), and in June 2008 the name was switched back to Hapoel Rishon LeZion following a change in ownership.[https://rlzfans.co.il/%D7%94%D7%99%D7%A1%D7%98%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%94%D7%9E%D7%95%D7%A2%D7%93%D7%95%D7%9F/ History of Hapoel Rishon LeZion F.C.] Hapoel Rishon LeZion fans Official Site {{in lang|he}}"}}
